blurb:
Discover the real Chicago with those who really know it!

At ChicaGo Turismo we transform a simple tour into an unforgettable experience. More than visiting monuments, you’ll discover the history, architecture, art, mob, cinema and secrets that made Chicago one of the most influential cities in the world.

You’ll walk through iconic places and corners that most visitors never get to know: the Riverwalk, the fascinating Pedway, spectacular Tiffany domes, historic buildings, movie settings like The Intouchables, Batman and Transformers, plus the stories of Al Capone, Eliot Ness, the Dry Law and other characters that marked the city.

Our 100% Spanish tours are guided by certified experts who turn each stop into an exciting story. You won’t just know Chicago; you’ll understand why millions of people fall in love and why this experience will be one of the best memories of your trip.
